text:
marta: Heads up — new candidate 'argent-40b' landed from model-scout. Need a quick triage and a suggested priority slot for the sprint. TL;DR: promising F1s but quantization shows long-prompt degradation.

priya: can you paste the eval snapshot?

marta: sure, pasted the short perf dump below (run was seq=1024):
```
perplexity: 12.8
avg_token_latency_ms: 48
winrate_vs_lyra13b: 0.68
quant_int8_delta_regression: 4.7% on long-prompts
memory_peak_gb: 22.1
```

sam: quick read — accuracy looks good, latency is acceptable for hosted but quant regression is a red flag for low-cost tier. My preliminary priority: 6/10.

devin: can we get a smoke bench with seq=2048 and batch=4? command: `./bench --model argent-40b --seq 2048 --bs 4 --quant int8`

onboard-bot: scheduled bench job argent-40b:job-442 queued (est 18m).

priya: taking quant smoke. I'll run 3 quant configs (int8, nf4, q4_k_m) and compare regression slices: {billing_prompts, codegen, entity-extraction}. Will post artifacts to /mnt/artifacts/argent-40b/ by EOD.

marta: thanks. Propose we slot canary for next sprint Monday 09:00 PT if quant smoke passes. Tentative rollout plan: canary -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with auto-rollback on quality/regression alerts.

devin: I'll own rollout hooks & monitoring (traces + token-level regression alerts). Adding a circuit-breaker to fall back to lyra13b if winrate dips >3%.

sam: gating checklist (very short):
- perf bench >= target
- quant smoke artifacts + delta < 2.5% on key slices OR documented mitigation
- scorecard added to evals dashboard
- SLO/rollback policy in console

marta: action items: @priya quant smoke + artifacts, @devin rollout hooks + CB, @sam scorecard & gating. I'll add sprint ticket and mark tentative slot. :thumbsup:

priya: acknowledged, will post results here.

sam: +1

marta: closing thread for now — will update when bench artifacts land.
